Class DrawCardVisitor

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.visitors.DrawCardVisitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardVisitor
public class DrawCardVisitor extends Object implements CardVisitor
Visitor that executes the draw action for a card on behalf of the current player.

Implements the Visitor pattern on CardVisitor: visits a card and applies the appropriate effect depending on its type. If the action cannot be performed, an error message is set and can be retrieved via getErrorMessage().
